bug_semantics: x0vncserver captures the local X screen into an MIT-SHM segment created with shmget(IPC_PRIVATE, size, IPC_CREAT|0777). Mode 0777 makes the segment world-readable and world-writable, so another local user can observe framebuffer contents, overwrite what is sent to VNC clients, or crash x0vncserver by racing the mapping. CWE-732. Fixed by tightening the mode to 0600.
flaw_origin: The world-writable shmget mode was first written in the 2004-10-08 SVN import of x0vncserver/Image.cxx (Image::createShmImage). A 2005 rewrite moved the same IPC_CREAT|0777 call into ShmImage::Init; a 2006 directory migration moved the file to unix/x0vncserver/Image.cxx. Those later commits carried the already-vulnerable permission; they did not introduce it.
